# Substrate presets

<!-- Generated by tools/build-docs.mjs from js/substrates.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Select one with `.substrate ID` in a netlist, optionally overriding any value, e.g. `.substrate jlc-fr4-1.6 er=4.3`, or describe your own board with `.substrate custom h=… er=… [tand=…] [t=…]`. See the [manual](manual.md#36-substrates) for the syntax.

Values marked † are assumptions rather than published data; each preset lists its assumptions and sources below the table.

## Assumptions, notes and sources

### FR-4

Presets: `jlc-fr4-0.4`, `jlc-fr4-0.6`, `jlc-fr4-0.8`, `jlc-fr4-1.0`, `jlc-fr4-1.2`, `jlc-fr4-1.6`, `jlc-fr4-2.0`

**Assumed:**

- loss tangent 0.02 at 1 GHz is a typical FR-4 value; JLCPCB does not publish one
- dielectric h = board thickness − 2 × 1 oz copper; JLCPCB does not publish the 2-layer core thickness, and board thickness tolerance is typically ±10 % — confirm for impedance-critical work

**Notes:**

- FR-4 εr varies with glass style, resin content and frequency; treat 4.5 as nominal

**Sources:**

- <https://jlcpcb.com/capabilities/pcb-capabilities> — FR-4 εr 4.5 (2-layer), thicknesses, min trace/space 0.10/0.10 mm, min via hole 0.15 mm, 1 oz outer copper (accessed 2026-10-18)

### Rogers RO4350B

Presets: `jlc-ro4350b-0.508`, `jlc-ro4350b-0.762`, `jlc-ro4350b-1.524`

**Assumed:**

- fabrication limits taken as JLCPCB standard 2-layer rules; not published separately for Rogers

**Notes:**

- εr is the Rogers design Dk 3.66 (recommended for circuit design); the process Dk is 3.48 at 10 GHz, the value JLCPCB quotes
- Df 0.0031 at 2.5 GHz, 0.0037 at 10 GHz
- JLCPCB also quotes finished thicknesses of 0.6 / 0.9 / 1.65 mm for these cores; h here is the core thickness

**Sources:**

- <https://jlcpcb.com/pcb-fabrication/high-frequency-pcb> — RO4350B and PTFE materials with Dk/Df, 2-layer only (accessed 2026-10-18)
- <https://jlcpcb.com/blog/112-rogers-pcb-ptfe-pcb-high-frequency-pcb-is-available-on-jlcpcb> — RO4350B 0.51/0.76/1.52 mm, PTFE 0.76/1.52 mm, 2-layer, 1 oz (post dated 2023-03-09) (accessed 2026-10-18)
- <https://rs.jlcpcb.com/static/file/rogers-ro4350b-datasheet.pdf> — RO4350B design Dk 3.66, process Dk 3.48 (10 GHz), Df 0.0037 @ 10 GHz / 0.0031 @ 2.5 GHz (accessed 2026-10-18)

### PTFE ZYF255DA

Presets: `jlc-zyf255da-0.762`, `jlc-zyf255da-1.524`

**Assumed:**

- test frequency for Dk/Df not stated by JLCPCB; 10 GHz assumed
- fabrication limits taken as JLCPCB standard 2-layer rules

**Notes:**

- JLCPCB lists 0.76 / 1.52 mm in one place and 0.65 / 0.9 / 1.65 mm (finished) in another; confirm before ordering

**Sources:**

- <https://jlcpcb.com/pcb-fabrication/high-frequency-pcb> — RO4350B and PTFE materials with Dk/Df, 2-layer only (accessed 2026-10-18)
- <https://jlcpcb.com/blog/112-rogers-pcb-ptfe-pcb-high-frequency-pcb-is-available-on-jlcpcb> — RO4350B 0.51/0.76/1.52 mm, PTFE 0.76/1.52 mm, 2-layer, 1 oz (post dated 2023-03-09) (accessed 2026-10-18)
